title: About
text:
I am an urban planner and spatial analyst focused on making cities easier to walk, bike, and live in. My day-to-day involves mapping public transit gaps, analyzing pedestrian safety data, and translating dense municipal reports into clear, visual stories for local communities.

title: About
text:
The Side Quest
When I step away from city maps, I spend most of my weekends restoring vintage mechanical typewriters. The hobby started by accident after I found a jammed 1960s portable model at a local thrift shop and decided to take it apart on my kitchen table.



Remington typewriter. Clas Ohlson museum in Insjön near Leksand in Dalarna. Available at: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Remington_typewriter.JPG

title: Ariana Gomez
text:
Hi! I’m Ariana, an undergraduate studying Geophysics at UCSB. I’m passionate about seismology, tectonics, and understanding the Earth’s mantle.
Right now, I’m exploring anti-repeating earthquakes in the Californian Sierra Valley and building my skills in Python and Fortran. Outside the classroom, you can usually find me swimming at the Recreation Center.
Take a look at my recent work on the Projects page, or feel free to reach out—I’d love to connect!
